comment: Migration ledger for the Spack->native hillclimb. We walk build_graph.json's topological_order one package at a time (dependencies before dependents), deep-dive each node's Spack build to capture its recipe (docs/recipes/<pkg>.md), then flip its provider to a native Bazel build gated by the ABI-parity test. Toolchain nodes (compiler-wrapper/gcc/glibc/gcc-runtime/gmake) are supplied by Bazel's own C toolchain and are not migration targets. status: not-a-target | spack | recipe-captured | native (ABI-gate green).
front: gloo is the active pruned lean py-torch frontier at lean py-torch topo index 121 after py-networkx moved native for NP-15 torch.compile runtime closure. The FC-14 py-networkx default/extra pruning remains in force, so LLVM, py-llvmlite, py-numba, py-pandas, py-scipy, py-matplotlib, and pythran stay out of the PyTorch closure through NetworkX. py-protobuf remains a native exact-version ODR/ABI island at lean py-torch topo index 99. PyTorch Python line decided 2026-09-28 as python@3.13.13; native python@3.13.13 is captured with an exact provider. The pruned graph still contains a separate build-only python@3.14.5 node for build tools, so Python-bound native package work remains governed by .scratch/pytorch-frontier-convergence ticket 08.

py-torch.note: Generated inside the CUDA insula via Bazel's @spack_dist//:spack with VASO_GRAPH_ONLY=1 and VASO_GRAPH_NO_PREFIX=1. The current frontier graph is the PyTorch 2.14 full CUDA closure for cuda_arch=100 with the human scope decisions applied: ~magma, ~mkldnn, and ^py-networkx~default. The pruned solve has 144 nodes, keeps py-networkx default=false, keeps the LLVM/numba/pandas/scipy/matplotlib extras chain out of the torch closure, and includes the CUDA-family rootfs boundary nodes cudss, nccl, and nvshmem plus gloo for the distributed gate surface.
